questions.question: Reasoning Puzzle #91: In a seating alignment of 116 candidates facing North, Priya is ranked 6th from left. Simultaneously, a runner travels 185 km North, turns East 274 km, then South 185 km. What is Priya's rank from right and runner's net displacement?
questions.hint: Rank from right = Total (116) - Left (6) + 1 = 111th. North/South movements cancel, leaving 274 km East.
